description: Initialized the reactor, verified stirrer and temperature probe calibration, and confirmed cooling fluid circulation.
Added 500 mL Precursor A (lot P-A-112), then 200 mL Reagent B (lot R-B-089). Mixed at 350 rpm.
Ramped temperature to 120 °C at 5 °C/min under reflux (condenser water 18 °C).
Held at 120 °C for 45 minutes until the solution turned deep amber, indicating completion of the primary exothermic phase.
Decanted supernatant; cake washed once with cold diethyl ether (volume not recorded in this excerpt).
